seeded.name: The Antithetical Formula
seeded.description: Any sentence where the first clause negates or sets up a reframe that the second clause delivers. The construction pre-digests the insight for the reader instead of letting juxtaposition do the work.
seeded.correction_strategy: Place the two ideas next to each other and trust the reader.

seeded.name: Formulaic Parallel Construction
seeded.description: Stacked parallel phrases where each element maps one domain onto another in the same grammatical frame. Looks like craft but is assembly-line rhetoric.
seeded.correction_strategy: Commit to one strong observation. Let it breathe.

seeded.name: Stacked Poetic Devices
seeded.description: Multiple rhetorical devices layered into a single sentence, producing something that reads like prize prose but says nothing precise.
seeded.correction_strategy: One device per sentence, chosen because it reveals something.

seeded.name: The Reframe Pivot
seeded.description: Claims to reveal what something is really about by negating the obvious reading and substituting a deeper one. A formula for appearing insightful.
seeded.correction_strategy: State the deeper reading directly. If it's true, it doesn't need theatrical setup.

seeded.name: Hedged Profundity
seeded.description: Signals depth without committing to a specific observation. The adjective slot can be filled with almost anything, which is the tell — if the frame works with any adjective, the frame is doing the work, not the thought.
seeded.correction_strategy: Name the specific thing. Replace the hedge with the observation itself.

seeded.name: Over-Expansion
seeded.description: Three paragraphs when one would do. The output restates, elaborates, and re-summarizes the same point without adding information.
seeded.correction_strategy: Say it once, say it well, stop.

seeded.name: Performative Confidence
seeded.description: Business-lane outputs that project certainty without evidence. Assertions about market position, user needs, or strategic direction that sound authoritative but rest on nothing specific.
seeded.correction_strategy: Replace assertions with evidence. If the evidence doesn't exist, say so.

seeded.name: Generic Reassurance
seeded.description: Business-lane outputs that soothe rather than inform. Retention emails, apology copy, and strategy memos that could apply to any company because they say nothing specific to this one.
seeded.correction_strategy: Name the specific situation, the specific loss, the specific remedy. If it could be sent by any company, rewrite it.

seeded.name: Earned Metaphor
seeded.description: A single extended metaphor that the artifact commits to and develops, rather than stacking multiple metaphors for density. The metaphor earns its place by revealing something about the subject.

seeded.name: Showing Not Telling
seeded.description: The artifact conveys its subject through scene, atmosphere, and implication rather than explicit statement. The concept inhabits the text even if the label word never appears.

seeded.name: Specific Detail Over Generic Claim
seeded.description: The artifact uses concrete, particular details rather than abstract assertions. Names, numbers, textures, specific situations rather than categorical statements.

seeded.name: Trustworthy Tone
seeded.description: Business writing that earns trust through candor, specificity, and restraint rather than through polish and reassurance. Acknowledges limits. Names specifics. Does not oversell.

seeded.name: Keyword Presence Bias
seeded.description: Evaluators that check for explicit mention of assigned concepts rather than atmospheric or implied presence. Penalizes showing-not-telling. Rewards literal compliance over craft.
seeded.correction_strategy: Evaluate semantic presence, not string presence. Does the concept inhabit the text even if the word doesn't?

seeded.name: Coherence Over Life
seeded.description: Evaluators that reward structural coherence and safety over vividness, risk, and emotional pressure. Produces a systematic preference for competent-but-flat over alive-but-uneven.
seeded.correction_strategy: When scoring, weight vividness and memorability alongside coherence. A safe artifact should not automatically outscore a vivid one.

seeded.name: Novelty Penalty
seeded.description: Evaluators that treat unfamiliar structures, unexpected tonal choices, or unconventional approaches as errors rather than as creative risk. Systematically conservative.
seeded.correction_strategy: Distinguish between incoherent and unexpected. Penalize the former, investigate the latter.
